description: Score a draft mechanically against the caller's own measured posts, without spending tokens. Returns a 0-100 score where every point is explained (hook, length, hashtags, slop markers, links, top-theme match, call to action), the baseline it was scored against (top angles by engagement), and the publish check for the requested network (linkedin, youtube, instagram, bluesky, threads): it fails only on an empty draft or the network's own ceiling where this repo has evidence for it (LinkedIn 3000 characters, Threads 500 characters, Bluesky 300 graphemes); the rest are warnings. A failing publish check means: fix the draft before scheduling it for that network. Pass kind 'script' for a video script (segments joined by newlines, hook first, CTA last): hashtags are not scored and publishCheck is null.

draft.description: The text to score: a post body, or with kind "script" the video segments joined by newlines, hook first, CTA last.

kind.description: What the text is. Defaults to post.

network.description: Network the draft is for; the publish check uses that network's rules. Defaults to linkedin.

personaId.description: Optional persona id: score against that persona's measured posts only.

name: score_draft
